basic_profile.bio: An enthusiastic hobbyist from Melbourne, Australia, who loves diving into creative projects during the evenings. By day, I work as a junior software developer, but my real passion lies in exploring parametric design and architecture software like Rhino and Grasshopper. When I'm not coding or designing, I'm either taking my dog for a walk or catching up on the latest memes. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it brings to pursue my interests. Typically, I'm online during the evenings and weekends, where you can find me lurking in subreddits related to my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in computer science from my university days, which I further enhanced with self-taught skills in 3D modeling and design software. My job requires a good grasp of programming, which complements my hobby of tinkering with design software like Rhino. I frequently explore tutorials and community forums to improve my skills.
